bio: I am a 3D Environment Artist specializing in modeling, texturing, and lighting for game and animation environments, with a Diploma in 3D Animation from MAAC. I love turning imagination into reality through my artworks — building beautiful environments using Unreal Engine and Maya, from blocking out scenes to detailed texturing and surface work that brings depth and realism to a space. I am currently looking for full-time opportunities as a 3D Environment Artist, where I can contribute to environment art pipelines for games, animation, or VFX projects.
contactDescription: Looking for opportunities to work as a 3D Environment Artist across games, animation and VFX. Open to full-time opportunities.
seoDescription: 3D Environment Artist specializing in Unreal Engine 5, 3D modeling, texturing, lighting and game environments.

awards.description: Awarded Jury Winner for 3D Environment Art at Punjab Animation Award, MAAC. Created a detailed 3D environment focusing on modeling, texturing and lighting to build a realistic scene, recognized among peers for overall quality and execution.

Nominated for 3D Character Modeling & Texturing at 24FPS International Award, MAAC. Modeled and textured a character asset with attention to detail in surfacing and material work, shortlisted among top entries in the category.
